Home.heroBadge: Early demo — sample data, not real transactions
Home.heroTitle: Get ready-mix concrete quotes from top suppliers in one place
Home.heroSubtitle: Submit one request and receive quotes from verified ready-mix concrete companies near your site, then compare and choose with confidence.
Home.howItWorksSubtitle: Four simple steps from order to pour
Home.step1Desc: Set your site location, concrete type, quantity and preferred time.
Home.step2Desc: Matching companies get your request and send quotes without seeing your contact details.
Home.step3Desc: Compare prices and ratings, then accept the offer that suits you best.
Home.step4Desc: Once you accept, the company's contact details are shared with you. Receive your order, then rate your experience.
Home.privacyDesc: Your name and phone number are never shared with any company until you accept their quote yourself.
Home.shuganDesc: Kharasana Pro's founding partner, serving East Riyadh projects with long-standing expertise in ready-mix concrete manufacturing and supply.
Home.shuganFleetSubtitle: Real photos from Shugan group projects
Home.shuganFleetPump1: A concrete pump at work on site
Home.shuganFleetPump2: A pump and mixer truck during a pour
Home.shuganFleetMixer2: A ready-mix concrete truck on a project site
Home.userCustomerDesc: Submits one concrete request and compares quotes.
Home.userCompanyDesc: Receives matching requests and sends price quotes.
Home.userRepDesc: Refers customers and companies and earns commission.
Home.userAdminDesc: Manages the platform, approvals and analytics.
Home.locationDesc: We're launching with East Riyadh districts, with a phased plan to expand to more cities.
Home.footerDemo: All data shown in this demo is sample data and does not represent real transactions.
